Quwat — qurilish materiallari va xo‘jali: Quwat is the online platform of a building materials and household supplies store. Browse everything you need for construction, repairs or everyday household tasks in one place and prepare for your purchase.
Kerakli buyumni topish va tanlashni oson: Our purpose is to make finding and choosing the right supplies easier. Checking product names, prices, descriptions and available quantities in advance helps you plan your shopping list. Quwat brings searching, selecting and submitting a purchase request together in one place.
Katalogimizda asboblar, mahkamlash buyum: Our catalog includes tools, fasteners, plumbing supplies, electrical supplies, paints and adhesives, door hardware and household supplies. Search by name or category and narrow your selection by brand, price and unit.
Mahsulot sahifasida uning rasmlari, tavs: Each product page shows photos, a description, price and stock quantity. Check units such as pieces, bags, metres or kilograms when choosing the quantity you need. Prices are shown in Uzbek sums (UZS).
Hisobingizga kirgach, yoqtirgan mahsulot: After signing in, you can like products and add them to Saved products for later. The Recently viewed list in your account makes it easy to return to previous selections.
Xarid uchun tanlangan mahsulotlarni sava: Add the products you want to buy to your cart. You can adjust quantities and see each item's amount and the total for all products.
Katalogdan mahsulot tanlab, savatchaga q: Choose products from the catalog, add them to the cart and set the quantities.
Jami summani tekshiring, naqd yoki bank: Check the total, choose cash or bank card and submit your purchase request.
So‘rov yuborilgach, tanlangan miqdor ban: After submission, the selected stock is reserved. An agent confirms that payment was received at the store.
So‘rov holati va tasdiqlangan xaridlarin: Track request statuses and confirmed purchases under My purchases in your account.
Tasdiqlanmagan so‘rovni “Xaridlarim” bo‘: You can cancel an unconfirmed request under My purchases. Choosing bank card records a card payment received at the store; the platform does not automatically charge your card.
Platformadan foydalanishga oid tushuntir: Visit Help for guidance on using the platform. You can view store agents' profiles in Agents and leave comments on product pages.

Saqlash — keyinroq ko‘rish uchun shaxsiy: Saving adds a product to your personal list for later. Liking expresses your interest in a product. They work independently.
